formationEvidence.reason: 4-2-3-1 common in adjacent seasons but exact 2023-24 final match formation frequencies not established; provisional tactical selection, not categorical season mode.

psg.note: Luis Enrique 4-3-3; Mbappé primarily centre forward, Barcola LW, Dembélé RW, Vitinha and Zaïre-Emery as interiors, Ugarte holding. Rotation Fabián Ruiz, Gonçalo Ramos; Marquinhos and Danilo often selected CB.

monaco.note: Hütter's 3-4-2-1 representative with Singo, Maripán, Kehrer on three back, Jakobs and Vanderson wingbacks, Zakaria and Fofana midfield, Minamino and Golovin free between lines. Seasonal modal match count not independently proven.

brest.note: Eric Roy's 4-3-3 with Lees-Melou holding and Magnetti/Camara as interiors; Locko and Lala fullbacks, Del Castillo right side, Le Douaron left, Satriano/Mounié striking options.

lille.note: Fonseca 4-2-3-1 with André + Angel Gomes pivot, Yusuf Yazıcı/Cabella shared 10, Haraldsson left, Zhegrova right and Jonathan David striker, Leny Yoro dominant centre-back.

nice.note: Farioli possession 4-3-3, Rosario holding, Thuram and Sanson interiors; Boga LW, Laborde RW and Moffi centre. Ndayishimiye central defence/holding role ambiguous.

lyon.note: After 2023 coaching changes, Pierre Sage's representative 4-2-3-1: Matić January arrival defensive midfield, Caqueret central, Cherki 10, Benrahma left midseason, Nuamah right, Lacazette striker.

lens.note: Haise three CB Danso/Medina/Gradit, Machado and Frankowski wingbacks, Samed and El Aynaoui central, Pereira da Costa and Sotoca behind Wahi; Sotoca mapped RW in website positional taxonomy.

bestXiReview.reason: 2023-24 individual form over team placement: Donnarumma, Marquinhos/Yoro, Locko/Hakimi, Lees-Melou/Vitinha, Minamino, Golovin/Dembélé, Mbappé. UNFP awards give external check but no automatic grade based on club successes.
